result.explanation: The shortest route from J0 to J299 by road distance is J0 → J15 → J16 → J17 → J32 → J33 → J48 → J49 → J297 → J298 → J299. It totals 67.24 km over 10 road segments. This was computed with Dijkstra's algorithm using distance_km as the edge length on the full graph, which is a single connected component. Roads were treated as two-way (undirected) because no edges in the data are reciprocated. For comparison, the fewest-segments route (unweighted) also takes 10 hops, J0 → J1 → J16 → J17 → J18 → J19 → J34 → J49 → J297 → J298 → J299, but its distance in km was not computed, so the two routes can't be compared on length. Both returned paths were checked as valid walks in the graph, and there were no verification warnings.
